steps.en: A daily job runs at 00:05 to build the list
steps.id: Job harian berjalan jam 00:05 untuk membuat daftar

steps.en: Notices are picked by suspension, unpaid and age
steps.id: Notice dipilih berdasarkan suspension, belum dibayar, dan umur
steps.why_en: Vehicle registration type is not part of the selection, and there is no separate tagged flag.
steps.why_id: Vehicle registration type tidak dipakai dalam pemilihan, dan tidak ada flag tagged tersendiri.

steps.en: A list file is built with one line per vehicle
steps.id: File daftar dibuat dengan satu baris per kendaraan

steps.en: The file is sent to the enforcement system
